description: 20th-century insights on the weekly Torah portion from the founder of the Ner Yisrael Yeshiva in Baltimore. Complete Musar text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Musar is Jewish ethical and devotional literature concerned with character, discipline and the conduct of ordinary life. Its genre ranges from short letters to systematic treatises.
